info.name: Grubhub Deliveries Delivery Status Order Polling API

params.name: status
params.description: Filter orders by their current status.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start of the date range filter in ISO 8601 format.

params.name: end_date
params.description: End of the date range filter in ISO 8601 format.

items.docs: Returns all orders for a group of merchants in a given state within the given time range. This is a fallback mechanism; new orders should primarily be received through webhook subscriptions rather than periodic polling.
